tasks.short: Collect verify and record cash or chip bets

steps.what: Physically count the presented cash or chips and capture the actual denomination quantities and wager reference in the {OPS_SYSTEM} wagering terminal
Calculate the amount from the captured denomination quantities and fixed values in the {OPS_SYSTEM} terminal
Verify the actual tender, calculated amount and wager match and make the immediate decision whether collection may proceed
Collect bets in the form of cash or chips by taking custody of the exact verified tender
Record the actual collected amount and wager reference in the {OPS_SYSTEM} collection entry and check its completeness and match to custody
Save the completed collection entry in the same {OPS_SYSTEM} record

tasks.design: Configure fixed denomination arithmetic and exact amount/reference reuse in the {OPS_SYSTEM} wagering terminal. The writer physically counts and verifies tender, takes custody and records the actual collection; software neither accepts a wager autonomously nor manufactures a collection record before receipt.
tasks.previous_blocker: A manually counted collection may require separate arithmetic and repeated amount entry.
tasks.enabler_now: Native denomination fields and linked collection entries can remove those operations.
tasks.still_hard: Tender authenticity, disputed amounts and mismatch with the wager need human resolution.
tasks.human_edge: The writer stops collection when actual tender and the request disagree.

ambition.what: No automated gambling or payment authority.

build_days.consent_and_access: 3-8 for transaction access, control review and national staff consultation where applicable

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: fixed denomination arithmetic and exact collection-field reuse can reduce manual calculation without replacing cash verification.

assumptions: Representative episode has actual manual denomination arithmetic and a collection entry. S1 physically counts and captures every quantity and reference; controlled denomination values already exist in the terminal configuration and are checked under ordinary operations. Missing or disputed counts return to manual resolution.

S2 explicitly performs the proposed calculation; s5 captures actual custody and checks every amount. Native terminal configuration first; existing totals or automatic collection recording earn no new gain. A count already totalled by the current terminal has no calculation saving.

S3 is the actual immediate tender-collection decision, not self-approval of authored paperwork. A1 covers only the exact tender, amount and wager just checked; any change requires another check. The ordinary same-system save is negligible, minimum share 1 fully retained and ungated.

Wager selection, eligibility checks, financial acceptance, ticket issue and any receipt are not silently performed by this collection-record save; if the actual terminal couples those effects, model their real authority and separate actions before using that broader episode. No new compliance labour is assumed free. Shares are provisional, not measured cashier times.
unknowns: Coupled wager acceptance or receipt effects
research_questions: Which calculation and repeated amount-entry actions genuinely remain manual?

already_counted.description: Physical count capture, current collection readiness and full record verification remain.

incremental.description: Verify denomination and collection-field mappings after terminal changes.

approvals.approved_version: Exact presented tender, calculated amount and wager reference checked in s3; changed tender or reference voids readiness

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=82.2, gross=17.8; upkeep 2 gives net 15.8. Low zero if native totals and collection fields already do the work, so introduce no duplicate configuration. Physical counting and collection retain all effort.

steps.what: Read and verify actual count sheets, collection records, drop totals and float references and capture the report period and reconciliation rules
Transfer exact table or counter, period, count and float fields into the {OPS_SYSTEM} collection-report draft
Total collections and compare them with drop and chip-float records under the captured rules in {OPS_SYSTEM}
Prepare collection reports for submission to supervisors by investigating variances, writing actual explanations and checking the entire report against original records
Save the completed report in the same {OPS_SYSTEM} working record without submitting it

tasks.design: Configure exact count-record import and explicit collection reconciliation in {OPS_SYSTEM}. The writer verifies sources, resolves discrepancies and completes every explanation; report preparation ends at a saved final draft, with no hidden submission.
tasks.previous_blocker: Collection reports may require repeated count transcription and reconciliation arithmetic.
tasks.enabler_now: Native report fields and fixed reconciliation calculations can perform those operations.
tasks.still_hard: A variance may indicate a missing record, disputed collection or real custody discrepancy.
tasks.human_edge: The writer investigates what actually happened rather than inventing a balancing explanation.

ambition.what: No automated variance disposition or supervisor decision.

build_days.consent_and_access: 3-7 for transaction access and control review; national staff consultation if monitoring changes

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: collection-report fields, totals and comparison with drop/float records can be deterministic while exceptions require investigation.

assumptions: Boundary is preparing the actual report for later submission, not issuing it. Cash handlers and count staff produce existing counted quantities and custody records in ordinary operations; s1 verifies them and captures period, units, keys and reconciliation rules. Missing or inconsistent source sheets require manual recovery, not a free clean feed.

S2 explicitly imports the exact fields and s3 explicitly totals and matches them. Native reporting first; existing scheduled reports, totals and matching earn no new gain. Paper-only sources still require counted transcription in s1; do not assume unreviewed extraction.

S4 retains every exception investigation, explanation and whole-report source check. No model supplies a reason for a variance. Same-system save is negligible, minimum share 1 fully retained and ungated without author self-approval.

Actual supervisor delivery, if part of the real episode, requires separate final-version authority and a send after the report exists; this preparation task does not silently mail it. Shares are provisional work decomposition, not measured report timings; no new count-staff labour is assumed free.
research_questions: Which count transfers and reconciliations are still manual rather than existing terminal runtime?

already_counted.description: Source verification and capture, variance investigation and whole-report checks remain.

incremental.description: Maintain source mappings and test reconciliation after collection-format changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=50, gross=50; upkeep 4 gives net 46. Conservative case: paper sources and heterogeneous count records leave only 12 transfer/reconciliation points avoidable, giving 12-4=8. Investigation and all report explanations remain.

tasks.short: Exchange currency for chips or coins

steps.what: Establish the requested exchange, allowed denominations and current fixed conversion values at the counter
Count and inspect the actual presented paper currency and capture denomination quantities in the {OPS_SYSTEM} counter terminal
Calculate exact currency total and chip or coin equivalent using the checked fixed values in {OPS_SYSTEM}
Physically select and count the actual playing chips or coins for the calculated exchange
Verify the actual tender and prepared exchange together, resolve discrepancies and decide whether this exact physical exchange may proceed
Receive the exact verified paper currency into counter custody
Exchange paper currency for playing chips or coins by handing over the verified prepared chips or coins after actual currency receipt
Write and check the actual currency receipt and chip or coin handover in the {OPS_SYSTEM} exchange record
Save the actual exchange entry in the same {OPS_SYSTEM} record

tasks.design: Configure fixed denomination arithmetic in the {OPS_SYSTEM} counter terminal. The writer counts actual money and chips, verifies the exchange, performs both physical handoffs and records the completed transaction; no payout or cash custody is automated.
tasks.previous_blocker: A manually handled exchange may require separate arithmetic.
tasks.enabler_now: Native fixed-value calculation can remove that calculation while showing its inputs.
tasks.still_hard: Tender authenticity, physical counts and disputes require direct handling.
tasks.human_edge: The writer catches a physical mismatch that correct arithmetic cannot detect.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-6 for counter access and control review; national consultation where applicable

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: fixed denomination arithmetic can assist a cash-for-chip exchange without replacing physical custody checks.

assumptions: Representative episode includes a required exchange record. S1 verifies actual requested denominations and controlled values; s2 physically counts and captures every input. Missing or disputed tender returns to manual resolution. Native configuration first; existing terminal/calculator arithmetic earns no new gain.

S5 is an actual immediate physical exchange-readiness decision, not author self-approval. A1 and a2 bind the same exact tender and prepared quantities; any change or failed currency receipt requires another s5 check before handover. Both handoffs are separate and fully retained.

S8 counts actual transaction writing and complete checking only after the physical exchange. The ordinary same-system save is negligible, minimum share 1 fully retained and ungated. No receipt issue or other financial transaction is hidden in the save; add such a real action separately if required.

If a concrete counter uses only aggregate drop recording rather than an individual exchange entry, remove the assumed entry and recalculate that episode, not invent administrative time. Shares are provisional active work, not measured counter timings. No work is transferred to patrons.
research_questions: Is there any manual denomination arithmetic left after current counter configuration?

incremental.description: Check controlled denomination calculation after counter configuration changes.

Same exact exchange checked in s5, conditional on actual receipt in s6; changes or failed receipt void readiness

tasks.short: Take the house percentage from pots

steps.what: Count the actual pot and capture its amount and the applicable current house percentage and cap in the {OPS_SYSTEM} table terminal
Calculate the house amount under the checked percentage, cap and rounding rule in {OPS_SYSTEM}
Select the actual chips corresponding to the calculated house amount from the pot
Verify the actual pot, calculated house amount and selected chips and decide whether this exact physical collection may proceed
Take the house percentage from each pot by physically removing the exact verified house amount

tasks.design: Configure fixed percentage, cap and rounding calculations in the {OPS_SYSTEM} table terminal where arithmetic is still manual. The writer counts and verifies the actual pot and removes the house amount personally; no pot settlement or custody transfer is automatic.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manual percentage and cap arithmetic can interrupt physical pot handling.
tasks.enabler_now: Native fixed-rule calculation can show the exact amount and rule inputs.
tasks.still_hard: The actual pot and chip selection must still be checked, and disputed amounts resolved.
tasks.human_edge: The writer notices when the physical pot differs from the recorded calculation input.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-6 for table access and control review; national consultation if staff monitoring changes

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: house percentage, cap and rounding arithmetic is deterministic when the pot and current rules are known.

assumptions: S1 counts the actual pot and captures all calculation inputs, including current rule selection. House management produces controlled existing rule values; no inferred rate or free pot sensor is assumed. Disputed amounts require manual reconciliation.

S2 explicitly performs the proposed arithmetic. Test native calculation first; existing electronic-table settlement or calculator runtime earns no new saving. The hypothetical manual-arithmetic episode must be observed before adoption.

S3 selects the actual chips after calculation; s4 makes the actual immediate physical collection decision, not self-approval of a document. A1 binds only the exact pot, house amount and chips just checked; changed conditions require another check. Actual collection is a separate fully retained action.

No individual per-pot report is established by this statement, so no such administrative baseline is invented. If an actual house-collection log is required, split its writing and evaluate native entry separately before estimating that expanded episode; shift collection reporting is separately covered in 8013. Shares are provisional, not measured pot-handling times.
research_questions: Does current equipment already calculate the house amount from the real pot?

already_counted.description: Actual pot capture and current physical house-collection verification remain.

incremental.description: Check current percentage, cap and rounding configuration after controlled rule changes.

approvals.approved_version: Exact pot, house amount and selected chips checked in s4; changed pot or rule input voids readiness

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=85, gross=15; upkeep 2 gives net 13. Low zero where existing electronic tables or fixed-value aids already remove the manual arithmetic, so introduce no duplicate configuration. Physical count, verification and collection remain.
